gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Sugar Shack Farms is a rustic wedding and event venue located in the beautiful small town of Milner, Georgia. It features a 3500 sqare foot reception barn and 4 outdoor ceremony sites on 30 acres of pasture with rolling hills, pecan trees, antique vehicles, and an 1893 homestead. Affordable wedding and event packages are available for every budget.
